name: I need a new shower installed ASAP — what should I do first?

mainEntity.name: I need a new shower installed ASAP — what should I do first?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you want a new shower installed fast, start by confirming whether you need a simple replacement, a tub-to-shower conversion, or a full remodel. The fastest projects are usually straightforward shower swaps; anything involving plumbing changes, waterproofing, or tile work needs more planning.
acceptedAnswer.description: Start by deciding whether you need a simple swap, a conversion, or a full remodel. The simpler the scope, the faster the install, but plumbing and waterproofing changes add time.
